games.name: [WIP] PASADA: Jeepney Legends
games.desc:
PASADA: Jeepney Legends (pre-alpha)

Game is currently CLOSED for updates. Please join the Discord server for more updates.

Drive, commute, and roleplay in South Luzon routes like Calamba, Los Baños, and Tanauan. Choose your role as a Driver or Passenger, master the roads, and experience the daily hustle of Filipino commuting.

🛺 Features in Pre-Alpha:

Realistic jeepney driving mechanics (engine, gears, handbrake, signals, headlights, horn)
Authentic South Luzon jeepney routes
Passenger AI system – pick up, drop off, collect fares, give change
Terminal queue system for realistic boundary payments
Signboard system

⚠️ Note: This is a Pre-Alpha build. Expect bugs, limited features, and resets. More updates, routes, and vehicles are coming soon!

👍 Follow & favorite the game to stay updated!
💬 Join our community to suggest routes, report bugs, and help shape PJL's future.
